capabilities: Copy a selected Canvas image node as real image data to the system clipboard
Copy regular Vault file nodes as native file references for Finder and other apps
Paste back into Canvas as cloned nodes referencing the same Vault image file
Rebind the copy shortcut in a settings tab, defaulting to Cmd+C on macOS
Run the copy action from the command palette
extras: Desktop-only (uses Electron's clipboard API) and only tested on macOS with Obsidian 1.13.7; Windows, Linux, and mobile are unverified. Not yet in the community plugin directory, so manual installation steps are provided. Runs locally with no network requests or telemetry.
problem: Copying a Canvas node in Obsidian does not put real image data or file references on the system clipboard, so pasting into other apps or browser upload fields fails.
summary: Canvas utility that copies a selected image or file node's actual content to the system clipboard via the normal copy shortcut.
